items.reason: A gentle starting strength of retinol for smoother-looking texture and more even-looking tone.
Retinol makes daily sunscreen essential, and this tinted mineral formula with iron oxides blends well on deeper skin tones.
A rich ceramide cream to comfort and cushion dry-looking skin while it adjusts to retinol.

response.routine_note: Apply the retinol at night 2 to 3 times a week at first, followed by the rich cream, and build up slowly as your skin feels comfortable. Use the tinted SPF every morning and reapply when outdoors.
